title: Edgeless Window Content Scroll Clearance
description: All content inside all windows must be edgeless. Remove padding inset; use scroll clearance so the first line is hidden under chrome by default but scrolls into view when scrolling up. Applies to writer, tables, and all window bodies.
summary: Chrome-aware windows (writer, forms, table, editor, vfs) are edgeless again: no body padding. Dead-island default clears the first line under floating chrome via initial scroll/camera offset (`--window-content-dead-line`); scrolling up reveals content edgelessly under chrome. Puzzle/canvas windows stay fully edgeless with no dead-line offset.
